Dance production ‘Muktir Mohaakkhyan’ honours Bangabandhu’s 7th March speech
2021-03-07T21:02:20+06:00 | Arts & Entertainment Desk
https://www.thedailystar.net/arts-entertainment/news/dance-production-muktir-mohaakkhyan-honours-bangabandhus-7th-march-speech-2056485

A dance production, "Muktir Mohaakkhyan" was arranged at Bangabandhu International Conference Center (BICC), in honour of Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujibur Rahman's iconic 7th March speech. Honourable Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina was the chief guest at the programme.

"Muktir Mohaakkhyan", choreographed by noted dancers Shamim Ara Nipa, Amit Chowdhury, Mehraj Haque Tushar, Saiful Islam Evan, Ariful Islam Arnob and Mashroor Rahman, featured dances, poems and creative performances, based on events that played an integral role in the independence of Bangladesh.
